recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white profile portrait of a male subject looking upward, framed within a dark, textured square with rounded corners and accented by metallic gold serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's upward gaze directs the viewer's eye toward the top text.
The gold typography provides a warm, metallic contrast to the cool grayscale image.
The rounded white border creates a physical frame that softens the dark, grainy background.
The central subject scale occupies approximately 60% of the vertical space.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or paper texture overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, positioned in lower-middle vertical space, rendered in a three-quarter profile view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyewear, highlighted by a strong directional light source from the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze upward to the top title, then drops down to the artist name at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark, textured negative space surrounds the subject to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black provide the background and shadow tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white and light grays define the subject's highlights and the outer border.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted metallic gold (approx. HEX #B89E67) for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in the image; high value contrast between shadows and highlights; low-saturation gold for text.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing to create a cohesive block of text
Slightly condensed proportions to fit long titles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both title and artist name to maintain formal consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary classical serif structure and high contrast.
Offers elegant transitions and sharp serifs consistent with the look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white profile photo of a person looking up, with heavy film grain and a dark textured background, framed in a white square with rounded corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps serif text in a muted gold color at the top and bottom center, ensuring tight tracking and high stroke contrast.

verificationChecks: Is the text a flat gold color without gradients?
Are the corners of the main frame rounded?
Is the grain texture visible across the entire dark area?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific person's likeness
Do not use the specific album title text
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on the subject's face.
Ensure the gold text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the rounded corner mask is symmetrical.
Confirm the texture does not obscure the subject's features.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W profile + Grainy dark background + Gold Serif All-Caps + Rounded Frame.
